source.inventory: Every source-type identifier the stated SDK baseline hands back at runtime, read inside an iOS simulator on that baseline. Derived aggregation contracts are listed separately and are not platform source types.
source.rowScope: rows contains exactly the runtime source-type identifiers of the stated SDK baseline, one row per identifier, and derived mappings are excluded and declared separately; where Apple declares more than one constant for an identifier, every declaring name is listed in symbols.

evidence.scope: HealthKit data-type families and public source concepts
Runtime identifiers, their declaring constants, and canonical documentation pages
Exact SDK baseline, retained source terminology, and source-file hashes

sourceTypeExtension.rule: Every admitted HealthKit output preserves its exact sourceTypeIdentifier in this lineage extension. Observation.code and DocumentReference.type remain clinical or document concepts; the HealthKit SDK source class is not asserted as an equivalent coding of either meaning.

clinicalRecordAdmission.rule: Admit a HealthKit clinical record only when HKFHIRVersion.fhirRelease is exactly dstu2 or r4. Copy that value to the one required release extension on the R4 DocumentReference envelope. Reject an unknown, missing, or future release before emission; preserve the provider-issued payload bytes exactly and never convert, re-encode, or infer their release from JSON shape.

statusVocabulary.supported: The current HealthKit adapter defines and validates emitted FHIR output.
statusVocabulary.mapped-standard: The source is represented by another exact Grove or authoritative standard package rather than a Mobile measurement profile.
statusVocabulary.platform-exclusive: The current adapter defines output through a platform-exclusive HealthKit profile whose meaning remains HealthKit-specific.
statusVocabulary.unmodeled: The source type is inventoried, but no shared or HealthKit-scoped profile models it and no output is admitted.
statusVocabulary.deferred: No FHIR output for this source type is admitted by the current adapter.
statusVocabulary.intentionally-unsupported: The Grove FHIR contracts explicitly reject this source meaning rather than approximating it.

observationIssued.rule: HealthKit exposes no per-object result-availability or modification instant. Omit Observation.issued; conversion, fetch, and upload times belong to Provenance.recorded or Bundle.timestamp and must not be substituted.

body-mass-index.reason: FHIR R4 already publishes an authoritative BMI profile; a one-source Grove Mobile wrapper would duplicate it.

outputs.effective: the exact same waveform effectivePeriod as the ECG Observation
outputs.relationship: average-heart-rate Observation.derivedFrom references the ECG Observation

callerEvidence: all HKElectrocardiogram.VoltageMeasurement values and timeSinceSampleStart offsets
the exact associated HKCategorySample objects when symptomsStatus is present

correlatedSymptomEvidence.rule: Each supplied HKCategorySample is converted through its existing HealthKit symptom Observation profile with its own source-record and source-output identities, exact effectivePeriod, and severity. The ECG hasMember Reference carries type Observation and that symptom's complete source-output Identifier. Duplicate References and samples outside the admitted seven source types fail closed; the number of associated samples is not capped by the number of admitted types.
correlatedSymptomEvidence.exchangeRule: A Mobile Exchange Bundle contains exactly one source-record revision, so a symptom Observation travels in its own event Bundle and normal conversion Provenance. The ECG uses an identifier-only logical hasMember Reference; it never embeds or relabels the symptom as an ECG child output.
correlatedSymptomEvidence.sourceRevisionRule: Each symptom event represents its HKSourceRevision through the normal HealthKit application/recording Device and conversion Provenance policy. Source-revision fields are not copied into a complex ECG extension.

wireMapping.classification: Observation.interpretation with exactly one coding from HealthKitECGClassificationVS
wireMapping.symptomsStatus: required healthkit-ecg-symptoms-status extension because notSet and none are not recoverable from hasMember count
wireMapping.algorithmVersion: Observation.method with exactly one coding from HealthKitECGAlgorithmVersionVS when present
wireMapping.samplingFrequency: validation input only; never emitted because SampledData.period carries the wire sampling interval
wireMapping.numberOfVoltageMeasurements: validation input only; never emitted because SampledData dimensions and data carry the wire frame count
wireMapping.sourcePeriod: required healthkit-ecg-source-period extension because waveform effectivePeriod may be narrower

electrocardiogram.effectiveRule: Observation.effectivePeriod starts at HKElectrocardiogram.startDate plus the exact first timeSinceSampleStart and ends at the exact last supplied voltage instant. The required healthkit-ecg-source-period extension separately preserves the HKElectrocardiogram startDate/endDate.
electrocardiogram.admissionRule: The caller supplies already-obtained evidence. The supplied voltage array length and SampledData whitespace-token frame count both equal numberOfVoltageMeasurements exactly; offsets are complete, unique, sorted, and satisfy offset[i] = offset[0] + i * SampledData.period exactly; every voltage is present. Canonicalize samplingFrequency and computed 1000 / SampledData.period to the producer's shortest round-trip base-10 decimal representation and require exact decimal equality (tolerance zero). Every associated symptom is supplied as its exact HKCategorySample and converted as its own admitted HealthKit Observation event. Missing, non-uniform, repeated-symptom-identity, resampled, or inconsistent evidence fails closed; the adapter performs no HealthKit query.

derivedAggregates.title: Sleep Duration Session Aggregate
derivedAggregates.requirement: This is not a HealthKit platform source identifier. The Grove FHIR contracts do not define the session-boundary aggregation contract; individual admitted samples map only to sleep stage.

rows.title: Hypertension Event
rows.requirement: Admit only the occurrence of the source platform's proprietary screening notification. The Observation code and result remain HealthKit-specific; no blood-pressure quantity, hypertension diagnosis, clinical finding, threshold, or algorithmic interpretation may be inferred. Cuff blood-pressure quantities remain a separate measurement surface.

rows.title: Activity Move Mode
rows.requirement: A ring-display preference has no semantically exact Mobile meaning, and converting it would encode an Apple product configuration as clinical data. The mode is interpretive context for the Apple move-time and active-energy rows, which carry their own units and are converted in their own right; it adds no measurement content of its own.

rows.title: Biological Sex
rows.requirement: Emit the healthkit-biological-sex Observation only for HKBiologicalSex.female, .male, or .other. LOINC 46098-0 'Sex' identifies the observation concept; do not relabel the source as LOINC 76689-9 'Sex assigned at birth', because HealthKit does not assert that provenance. Preserve the exact HealthKit result in the required Grove value set, and emit no Observation for .notSet.

rows.title: Date of Birth
rows.requirement: The mapping is defined, but disclosure is fail-closed: emit the healthkit-date-of-birth Observation only when deployment policy explicitly authorizes exchanging this direct identifier. Otherwise emit no resource. Never substitute an inferred date, silently reduce precision, or place the value on the pseudonymous exchange Patient; deployments that only require age must derive it under their own approved policy.

rows.title: Fitzpatrick Skin Type
rows.requirement: Emit the healthkit-fitzpatrick-skin-type Observation only for HealthKit's six stated Fitzpatrick categories, preserving the exact category in the required Grove value set. Treat the value as source-reported classification, not a measured or inferred skin phenotype, and emit no Observation for .notSet.

rows.title: ECG
rows.requirement: The caller supplies the HKElectrocardiogram, every voltage measurement with its exact timeSinceSampleStart, and each associated HKCategorySample when symptomsStatus is present. Classification is Observation.interpretation; Apple ECG algorithm version is Observation.method; optional average heart rate is a separate LOINC 8867-4 Observation derived from the waveform. Each supplied symptom is converted through its existing HealthKit symptom Observation profile as a separate source event, and the ECG hasMember carries that Observation's opaque source-output Identifier. Sampling frequency and reported count are validated against SampledData but are not duplicated on the wire. The adapter preserves source and waveform intervals, lead, offsets, and voltages without fetching or resampling.

rows.title: Heartbeat Series
rows.requirement: The beat-to-beat interval series is admitted as a recording document carrying the published beat-interval-series column schema. No shared measurement models a beat series, so the samples are carried rather than reduced to a scalar.

rows.title: User Annotated Medication Concept
rows.requirement: A non-archived tracked medication is admitted as a MedicationStatement identified by the HKHealthConceptIdentifier of its concept, carrying the person's nickname, the platform's general form, whether a schedule exists, and status active. An archived medication is not admitted, because archival alone does not establish that medication use was completed or stopped.

rows.title: CDA Document
rows.requirement: A CDA document is carried byte-for-byte as a recording document. Grove never asserts conformance over another issuer's document, the same treatment a provider-issued clinical record receives.

rows.title: Medication Dose Event
rows.requirement: A logged dose is admitted as a MedicationAdministration that keeps the exact HKMedicationDoseEvent.LogStatus and the schedule it was logged against beside the R4 status, which collapses six source cases onto three codes. The medication is named by the same HKHealthConceptIdentifier the tracked-medication statement carries.

rows.title: Blood Pressure (Diastolic)
rows.requirement: A diastolic quantity alone cannot populate the required two-component blood-pressure panel. Convert blood pressure only from HKCorrelationTypeIdentifierBloodPressure.

rows.title: Blood Pressure (Systolic)
rows.requirement: A systolic quantity alone cannot populate the required two-component blood-pressure panel. Convert blood pressure only from HKCorrelationTypeIdentifierBloodPressure.

rows.title: NikeFuel
rows.requirement: NikeFuel is an opaque vendor index with an unpublished formula and a retired ecosystem; it has no physiological dimension, no UCUM representation beyond an arbitrary annotation, and no second source, so normalizing it would launder an undefined score into an exchange measurement.

rows.title: Vision Prescription
rows.requirement: A glasses or contacts prescription is admitted as a structured R4 VisionPrescription: the lens specifications map natively, one HKVisionPrism resolves into its vertical and horizontal components, and vertex distance, the two pupillary distances, and the expiration date are represented by extensions. HealthKit supplies no prescriber, so the mandatory reference is stated absent rather than invented.

rows.title: Workout Route
rows.requirement: The recorded route is admitted as a recording document carrying the published location-track-samples column schema. A route re-identifies readily, so a producer discloses it only under an explicit route-disclosure authorization.

recordingDeviceIdentity.preferredStableUnitEvidence: HKDevice.localIdentifier when nonempty and the deployment has verified its stability for the acquisition scope; otherwise a caller-governed stable per-unit token.
recordingDeviceIdentity.fallback: Omit Observation.device when no governed stable per-unit token exists. Descriptive and version fields alone cannot establish a physical instance.
recordingDeviceIdentity.snapshot: When emitted, the Device carries both recording-device and event-scoped device-snapshot v0 identifiers; descriptive and version fields are event-time snapshot data.

bundleIdentifier.meaning: Exact Apple application product bundle identifier; never an installation, host, account, or person identifier.

applicationDeviceIdentity.classificationRule: The converting application always uses this profile. An HKSourceRevision author uses it only when the caller explicitly classifies that source as an application; never infer actor class from name, bundle text, UUID shape, or productType.

bindings.repository-scope-system: deployment-owned URI naming the HealthKit store scope
bindings.repository-scope-value: stable pseudonymous value for one HealthKit store

sourceOutput.outputRoleRule: Use the exact measurement id, native-recording, clinical-record, or other output role declared by the catalog row.
sourceOutput.outputDiscriminatorRule: Use single for a sole output. Multi-output rows use their exact catalog output discriminator plus canonical source coordinates; stable source coordinates take precedence over array order.

writerRecord.condition: HealthKit source metadata supplies a stable writer application Identifier pair and logical writer record id.
writerRecord.rule: Do not infer cross-channel writer identity from source name, bundle display text, or HKObject.uuid.

revision.identifierRule: The sync identifier must be a non-empty String and is used exactly as the writer-record-id component.
revision.versionRule: The NSNumber must represent an integral non-negative value; emit its canonical unsigned decimal text with zero represented as 0.

sourceArtifact.rule: A clinical or native recording uses its registered format code and zero-based part index in addition to the source-record coordinates.

sourceContext.rule: HKHealthConceptIdentifier is HMAC-protected as medication-health-concept context under the same deployment-owned repository scope and key epoch as its source records. A tracked medication and every dose reference use the same complete opaque Identifier pair.

identity.resourceIdPolicy: Resource.id is optional and repository-assigned. HealthKit source, output, writer, artifact, context, and event business identifiers are never copied into Resource.id.
